facts.text_en: The open pit is about 4 km wide, at roughly 4,100 m above sea level in the Sudirman Mountains; copper ore was discovered in 1936 and the Grasberg gold-bearing ore in 1988.
facts.text_es: El rajo tiene cerca de 4 km de ancho, a unos 4.100 m sobre el nivel del mar en los montes Sudirman; el mineral de cobre se descubrio en 1936 y el mineral aurifero de Grasberg en 1988.

facts.text_en: The final phase of the Grasberg open pit was mined during 2019; production now comes from the Grasberg Block Cave, the Deep Mill Level Zone and Big Gossan underground mines, and Freeport-McMoRan holds 48.76% of PT Freeport Indonesia (Freeport-McMoRan).
facts.text_es: La fase final del rajo Grasberg se extrajo durante 2019; la produccion viene ahora de las minas subterraneas Grasberg Block Cave, Deep Mill Level Zone y Big Gossan, y Freeport-McMoRan posee 48,76% de PT Freeport Indonesia (Freeport-McMoRan).
